snippet.title: Pool Friday - trailer - out now !!!
snippet.description:
https://bruneiros.itch.io/pool-friday

a game about having to work for a sketchy company after having graduated. a game in which you have to walk and read tons of text. a game that features a painting minigame. this is POOL FRIDAY. my thesis game for the animation course at UFSC, Pool Friday is a surreal comedy game that is well worth a deep dive or something water-related. features a myriad of different art styles, all coexisting peacefully and in harmony, and an all-original soundtrack with everything from dissonant folk tunes to industrial rock bangers. so what are YOU waiting for? GO PLAY POOL FRIDAY TODAY, THIS INSTANT, RIGHT NOW!

https://bruneiros.itch.io/pool-friday

you can also get the soundtrack and its prequels on bandcamp: 
https://infoleaks.bandcamp.com/album/pool-friday
https://infoleaks.bandcamp.com/track/pool-beats
https://infoleaks.bandcamp.com/track/pool-glitches
https://infoleaks.bandcamp.com/album/pool-guitar
